unit.title: Places, Objects, Numbers, and Colors
unit.unit_outcome: Recognize common surroundings and identify, count, and describe concrete objects without using untaught location language.
unit.dependency_chain: Unit 1 people/actions -> place identity -> transport identity -> object identity -> What questions -> this/that -> numbers -> colors -> composed noun phrases -> review -> mission
unit.cefr_evidence: Supports A1 recognition and production of familiar concrete words, very short identity questions, basic numbers, and simple supported descriptions of immediate surroundings.

lessons.title: Places Around Me
lessons.goal: Recognize and name six familiar places and use it for a non-person identity statement.
lessons.grammar_function: A place; It is a/an place. No in/at/where language yet.
lessons.prerequisite: Unit 1 identity nouns, singular is, and clear action sentences.
lessons.speaking_outcome: Repeat five place identities and one familiar Unit 1 action sentence intelligibly.

scene_contract.park: clear public park with trees, path, grass, and bench; no school/store signage
scene_contract.school: clear school exterior with readable SCHOOL sign; no children needed to identify it
scene_contract.store: small storefront with display window and STORE sign; not a restaurant
scene_contract.house: single detached house exterior; not a general multi-story building
scene_contract.restaurant: unmistakable restaurant exterior with entrance, dining tables, and warm service cues; no written RESTAURANT label
scene_contract.hospital: hospital exterior identified only by a large H and universal medical symbol; never spell HOSPITAL in the image
scene_contract.boy-running: established Unit 1 boy visibly running on neutral background
scene_contract.girl-walking: established Unit 1 girl visibly walking on neutral background

Learn: introduces it with a known article/is frame
Recognize: storefront purposes must be visibly different
medical sign remains legible at phone size
Use: complete audio plays full answer afterward
Unit 1 review; all options previously learned

lessons.title: Streets and Transportation
lessons.goal: Recognize and name a street, bridge, bus, car, and bike using the established it identity frame.
lessons.grammar_function: It is a noun; no motion, driving, riding, or location prepositions.
lessons.speaking_outcome: Name all five surroundings/transport items in short identity sentences.

scene_contract.street: empty urban street seen clearly from curb; no bridge dominates
scene_contract.bridge: full bridge spanning visible water or gap; no ambiguity with ordinary road
scene_contract.bus: single full-size city bus in profile; not a van
scene_contract.car: single passenger car in profile; not a bus

Recognize: street and bridge full forms visible

lessons.title: Common Objects
lessons.goal: Recognize and name six high-frequency portable or classroom objects.
lessons.grammar_function: A noun; It is a noun.
lessons.speaking_outcome: Produce six short object identity sentences after a model.

scene_contract.book: one closed book centered on plain background; no pen or bag
scene_contract.pen: one capped ink pen centered; not a pencil
scene_contract.phone: one modern smartphone with blank screen
scene_contract.bag: one everyday backpack or shoulder bag; use one consistent form

lessons.title: What Is It?
lessons.goal: Understand, ask, and answer What is it? for known places, vehicles, and objects.
lessons.grammar_function: What is it? It is a/an known noun. What asks about a non-person thing; Who remains for people.
lessons.prerequisite: 2.1-2.3 it identity statements and Unit 1 Who questions.
lessons.speaking_outcome: Repeat six complete What is it? question-answer exchanges.

lessons.title: This and That
lessons.goal: Use this for one clearly near object and that for one clearly distant object.
lessons.grammar_function: This is a noun for a foreground/held object; That is a noun for an object across the scene. Singular only.
lessons.prerequisite: 2.3 object identities and 2.4 What question-answer frame.
lessons.speaking_outcome: Repeat three this sentences and three that sentences with clear initial consonants.

scene_contract.near-book: paired first-person demonstrative scene; left hand holds the near book while right hand points at it; identical far book remains visible
scene_contract.far-book: same paired scene; left hand keeps holding the near book while right hand points from below at the identical far book without overlapping or touching it
scene_contract.near-phone: paired first-person demonstrative scene; left hand holds the near phone while right hand points at it; identical far phone remains visible
scene_contract.far-phone: same paired scene; left hand keeps holding the near phone while right hand points from below at the identical far phone without overlapping or touching it
scene_contract.near-bag: paired first-person demonstrative scene; left hand holds the near bag while right hand points at it; identical far bag remains clearly readable
scene_contract.far-bag: same paired scene; left hand keeps holding the near bag while right hand points from below at the readable identical far bag without overlapping or touching it
scene_contract.near-chair: paired first-person demonstrative scene; left hand grips the near chair while right hand points at it; near chair is substantially larger than the identical far chair
scene_contract.far-chair: same paired scene and strong size contrast; left hand keeps gripping the large near chair while right hand points from below at the smaller identical far chair without overlapping or touching it
scene_contract.table: same isolated table from 2.3, with no chair

Learn: near cue introduced with foreground hand
far cue introduced with same object
Recognize: same object; distance is sole variable
Use: singular be agreement in the that frame

lessons.title: Numbers 1-10
lessons.goal: Recognize, hear, and say the number words one through ten without yet requiring plural object phrases.
lessons.grammar_function: Number-word identity only; regular noun plurals are intentionally deferred to 2.8.
lessons.prerequisite: 2.3 object recognition; numerals need no English grammar prerequisite.
lessons.speaking_outcome: Repeat six sampled number words clearly; remaining number words recur in 2.8 and the unit review.

lessons.title: Basic Colors
lessons.goal: Recognize, hear, and say six basic colors and use It is color for a clear color field.
lessons.grammar_function: It is red/blue/etc. Object color descriptions are deferred to 2.8.
lessons.prerequisite: 2.6 number recognition and earlier it identity frame.
lessons.speaking_outcome: Repeat all six color words in short It is color sentences.

scene_contract.blue: large matte blue circle on neutral light background
scene_contract.green: large matte green circle on neutral light background
scene_contract.yellow: large saturated yellow circle with dark outline on neutral background
scene_contract.black: large matte black circle on neutral light background
scene_contract.white: large white circle with dark outline on mid-gray background

lessons.title: Count and Describe
lessons.goal: Build and understand number plus color plus noun phrases for one to six familiar items.
lessons.grammar_function: English adjective order number + color + noun; singular after one and regular plural -s after two or more. No There are yet.
lessons.speaking_outcome: Repeat six accurately ordered descriptive noun phrases, including singular and plural forms.

scene_contract.six-white-bags: exactly six white bags with dark outlines

scene_contract.far-blue-bag: one blue bag across the room
